label: 8.2e Direct API Payments
openQuestions: CNP-02/CNP-14/CNP-15/CNP-16 and 3DS-01..03: UAT decline, AVS/CVV, partial approval and 3DS outcome trigger values are not documented in the source skills
All Payroc scenarios: UAT test card numbers and ACH/PAD test accounts not documented in the source skills
Test Tag length (about 30 chars) exceeds order.orderId 24-char limit documented for Apple Pay payments and Worldnet ORDERID; decide whether the tag goes in customFields or description
CNP-05/CNP-06: capture and adjust request body shapes not fully specified in the skill
CNP-14/CNP-18: billing address and tax object field names not specified
CNP-19: EBT payment request shape not covered by source skills
CNP-11: exact status for cumulative over-refund not stated
WN-02: whether totalAmount is decimal or minor units; WN-03: decline status code; WN-06: refund body; WN-08/WN-09: sandbox test data; production REST base URL not stated
ACH-08: ACH re-presentment limited and PAD unavailable in UAT

scenarios.title: Card sale approved (keyed, card-not-present)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a keyed card sale is created and authorised with immediate capture.
steps: Authenticate against the identity service and obtain a Bearer token.
POST /v1/payments with channel web, autoCapture omitted (default true), a fresh Idempotency-Key and the Test Tag in order.orderId.
Persist paymentId from the response.
Inspect transactionResult in the response body, not only the HTTP status.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with paymentId; transactionResult.responseCode A (approved). HTTP 201 alone does not prove approval.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Amount must be in minor units (5000 = 50.00). expiryDate is MMYY. Do not branch success on a single remembered transactionResult.status value.

scenarios.title: Card sale declined
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a decline is surfaced correctly and not treated as a successful payment.
steps: POST /v1/payments using the documented decline trigger.
Read transactionResult.status and responseCode in the response body.
Confirm the application does not mark the order paid and does not auto-retry.
scenarios.expected: Response carries a decline outcome (responseCode D per skill examples) in the body; no paymentId should be treated as captured.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: The API can return 201 for an issuer decline; the decline is in the body.

scenarios.title: Pre-authorization created
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies funds can be held by setting autoCapture false and processAsSale false.
steps: POST /v1/payments with autoCapture false and processAsSale false.
Persist paymentId to durable storage.
Confirm the response is an authorisation, not a captured sale.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with paymentId; responseCode A. The payment is not captured. Terminal must have pre-authorization enabled.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: If either flag is omitted or the terminal is not enabled, the request processes as a sale.

scenarios.title: Capture a pre-authorization in full
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a full capture of an existing pre-authorization.
steps: Create a pre-auth (CNP-03).
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/capture with no body (or {}) and a new Idempotency-Key.
Check transactionResult in the response.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with payment object; transactionResult.responseCode A.
scenarios.pitfalls: Use a fresh Idempotency-Key; never reuse the create key.

scenarios.title: Partial capture of a pre-authorization
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a capture for less than the authorised amount.
steps: Create a pre-auth for 10000.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/capture with a lower amount in the capture body.
Verify captured amount in the response.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; captured amount equals the requested lower amount.
scenarios.pitfalls: Capturing more than the hold requires the adjust endpoint first. Confirm the exact capture body shape against the API schema.

scenarios.title: Adjust a pre-authorization then capture
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the authorised amount can be adjusted before capture.
steps: Create a pre-auth.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/adjust with the new amount.
Capture the adjusted amount.
scenarios.expected: Adjust returns HTTP 200; subsequent capture succeeds for the adjusted amount.
scenarios.pitfalls: A payment cannot be adjusted after it has been captured or reversed. Adjust request body is not detailed in the source skill.

scenarios.title: Void a pre-authorization (reverse)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a hold can be released with a reversal and cannot then be captured.
steps: Create a pre-auth.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/reverse with a new Idempotency-Key.
Attempt a capture and confirm it is rejected.
scenarios.expected: Reverse returns HTTP 200; later capture is rejected.
scenarios.pitfalls: Reversal is permanent.

scenarios.title: Void a sale in an open batch (reversal)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an approved sale can be voided before settlement.
steps: Run a sale (CNP-01) and do not wait for batch close.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/reverse.
Retrieve the payment and confirm its state.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; payment is voided/reversed and no funds settle.

scenarios.title: Referenced refund (full) of a card payment
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a referenced refund against an existing paymentId.
steps: Use a settled (closed-batch) payment, or accept that an open-batch payment is reversed instead.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund with amount and description.
Capture refundId from payment.refunds[].
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with the payment object containing a refunds[] entry (refundId, status, amount, responseCode). On an open batch the gateway reverses instead of refunding.
scenarios.pitfalls: amount and description are both required. For the refund endpoint the Test Tag goes in description.

scenarios.title: Referenced partial refund
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a refund for less than the original amount.
steps: Select a payment of 5000.
POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund with amount 2000 and description.
Retrieve the payment and confirm refunds[].
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; refunds[] shows amount 2000.

scenarios.title: Refund exceeding the original amount is rejected
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an over-refund is rejected.
steps: POST /v1/payments/{paymentId}/refund with amount greater than the original payment amount (or cumulative refunds beyond it).
scenarios.expected: Request is rejected (4xx, expected 400 validation per skill: amount must be <= original). No refund is created.
scenarios.pitfalls: Exact status code for cumulative over-refund is not stated in the skill; confirm.

scenarios.title: Unreferenced refund (card)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a standalone refund with card details and no paymentId.
steps: Confirm the terminal is enabled for unreferenced refunds.
POST /v1/refunds with channel pos or moto, order (orderId, description, amount, currency) and refundMethod card.
Capture refundId.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with refundId. A 403 means the terminal is not enabled.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: channel is pos or moto only for refunds. All four order fields are required.

scenarios.title: Reverse (void) a card refund
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a refund in an open batch can be reversed.
steps: Create a refund (CNP-09 or CNP-12).
POST /v1/refunds/{refundId}/reverse.
Retrieve the refund and check transactionResult.status.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; transactionResult.status is reversal.
scenarios.pitfalls: Permanent; only while the refund is in an open batch.

scenarios.title: AVS and CVV data submitted
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies billing address data is accepted and AVS/CVV outcomes are returned.
steps: POST /v1/payments with cardholder CVV and customer.billingAddress populated.
Record any AVS/CVV result returned in the response.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201; address and CVV evaluated by the issuer. Response fields for AVS/CVV results are not documented in the source skills.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Billing address sub-field names are not specified in the source skill; confirm against the API schema.

scenarios.title: Partial approval handled
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a partial authorisation is handled when acceptPartialAmount is true.
steps: POST /v1/payments with order.acceptPartialAmount true using the documented trigger.
Read transactionResult.responseCode and authorizedAmount.
Confirm the application collects the shortfall.
scenarios.expected: responseCode P with authorizedAmount lower than the requested amount.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)

scenarios.title: Surcharge applied / bypassed
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies surcharge fields are accepted on a payment.
steps: Optionally run BIN lookup (VER-02) to read surcharging.allowed and disclosure.
POST /v1/payments with order.breakdown.subtotal and breakdown.surcharge.
Repeat with surcharge.bypass true.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201; surcharge reflected in the response amounts when allowed; bypass skips it.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Surcharging must be configured on the terminal. Exact response shape not documented in the source skill.

scenarios.title: Tip on a sale
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies tip data is accepted in the order breakdown.
steps: POST /v1/payments with breakdown.subtotal and breakdown.tip (type fixedAmount or percentage; mode prompted or adjusted).
Confirm the total reflects the tip.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201; total includes the tip.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: tip.mode adjusted is mainly for card-present flows; confirm applicability for CNP.

scenarios.title: Level 2/3 data (taxes and line items)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies enhanced-data fields are accepted for L2/L3 interchange.
steps: POST /v1/payments with breakdown.subtotal and breakdown.taxes (type amount or rate).
For L3 add dutyAmount, freightAmount and items with commodityCode, productCode, description, unitPrice, quantity.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with the data accepted.
scenarios.testData: Use a Payroc UAT test card from docs.payroc.com (card number not documented in the source skills; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Tax object value field names are not fully specified in the source skill; confirm against the API schema. Qualifying also needs a commercial/purchasing card.

scenarios.title: EBT card payment
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an EBT sale is accepted on an EBT-provisioned terminal.
steps: Confirm the terminal is in an EBT sharing group.
Run an EBT purchase via POST /v1/payments per Payroc EBT documentation.
Record the result.
scenarios.expected: Approved EBT transaction on the correct benefit category.
scenarios.testData: Use the EBT UAT test cards documented by Payroc (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: EBT payment request shape is not covered by the source skills; only the balance inquiry is (see VER-03).

scenarios.title: 3-D Secure frictionless authentication then sale
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the MPI flow and a payment posted with the mpiReference when no challenge is needed.
steps: Obtain a single-use token (TOK-01 or Hosted Fields).
GET https://payments.uat.payroc.com/merchant/mpi with processingTerminalId, singleUseToken, email, amount, currency, orderId (Bearer auth).
Receive the asynchronous GET callback; confirm result A, store mpiReference.
POST /v1/payments with channel web, paymentMethod singleUseToken and threeDSecure {serviceProvider gateway, mpiReference}.
scenarios.expected: Callback result A with eci 05 or 06; payment HTTP 201 with paymentId.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Callback is a GET, not POST. MPI host differs from API host. orderId, amount, currency must match between MPI and payment.

scenarios.title: 3-D Secure challenge then sale
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the cardholder challenge path (cardholderChallenge REQUIRED) completes and the payment posts.
steps: Send the MPI request with cardholderChallenge=REQUIRED.
Complete the challenge as the cardholder.
On callback result A, post the payment with mpiReference.
scenarios.expected: Callback result A after challenge; payment HTTP 201.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)

scenarios.title: 3-D Secure authentication failed - payment not posted
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a declined MPI result stops the payment.
steps: Send an MPI request with the documented failing-authentication trigger.
Receive callback with result D.
Confirm no POST /v1/payments is sent.
scenarios.expected: Callback result D; no payment created.
scenarios.testData: Use the UAT trigger documented at docs.payroc.com/... (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: Branch on result, not status; both use A with different meanings.

scenarios.title: ACH payment (US bank transfer)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an ACH payment is accepted and returns pending status.
steps: POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments with paymentMethod ach (routingNumber, accountNumber, nameOnAccount, accountType, secCode).
Persist paymentId.
Poll GET /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201; transactionResult.status pending (responseCode E) initially. Pending is not a failure.
scenarios.testData: Use ACH test account data documented by Payroc UAT (the skill example uses routing 053200983; confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: secCode is mandatory for ACH. Terminal must be ACH-enabled.

scenarios.title: PAD payment (Canadian)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a PAD payment using transit and institution numbers.
steps: POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments with paymentMethod pad and currency CAD.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201; status pending.
scenarios.testData: Use PAD UAT test data documented by Payroc (confirm with Payroc)
scenarios.pitfalls: No secCode for PAD. transitNumber is 5 chars and institutionNumber 3 chars.

scenarios.title: ACH payment missing secCode is rejected
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies request validation on a required ACH field.
steps: POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments with type ach and secCode omitted.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 400 with errors[].parameter naming secCode.

scenarios.title: Reverse an ACH payment in an open batch
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies an unsettled ACH payment is voided.
steps: Retrieve the payment and confirm it is unsettled.
POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/reverse (no body).
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; transactionResult.status reversal.

scenarios.title: ACH referenced refund on an open batch (auto-reversal)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a referenced refund on an unsettled bank transfer converts to a reversal.
steps: POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/refund with amount and description on an open-batch payment.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; transactionResult.type payment, status reversal, positive authorizedAmount (expected, not a failure).

scenarios.title: ACH unreferenced refund (settled payment)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies the only path to return a settled ACH payment.
steps: Confirm the terminal is enabled for unreferenced refunds.
POST /v1/bank-transfer-refunds with refundMethod ach (or secureToken).
Poll GET /v1/bank-transfer-refunds/{refundId}.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with refundId; transactionResult.type unreferencedRefund, status pending then complete.
scenarios.pitfalls: Referenced refund on a settled ACH payment returns 400; use unreferenced. processingTerminalId must be a string. 403 means terminal not enabled.

scenarios.title: PAD referenced refund (settled payment)
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a referenced PAD refund.
steps: POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{paymentId}/refund with amount and description on a settled PAD payment.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; transactionResult.type refund, negative authorizedAmount, status pending.
scenarios.pitfalls: Settlement timing in UAT is not documented.

scenarios.title: Re-present a returned ACH payment
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a returned ACH payment can be re-presented using the return's paymentId.
steps: Retrieve the original payment and read returns[].
POST /v1/bank-transfer-payments/{returns[0].paymentId}/represent.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with updated payment. Maximum two re-presentments.
scenarios.pitfalls: Use the return's paymentId, not the original. PAD re-presentment unavailable and ACH limited in UAT.

scenarios.title: Idempotent retry after timeout then status lookup
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies a timed-out payment is recovered with the same Idempotency-Key and a lookup, without double charging.
steps: Send POST /v1/payments and simulate a client timeout (discard the response).
Retry the identical request with the same Idempotency-Key and confirm the original response is returned.
GET /v1/payments?processingTerminalId=...&orderId=... (or GET /v1/payments/{paymentId}) and confirm exactly one payment exists.
scenarios.expected: Same paymentId returned on retry; one payment exists. Reusing the key with a different body returns 409.
scenarios.pitfalls: Idempotency-Key must be a UUID v4. Retry reuses key only for the identical request.

scenarios.title: Missing Idempotency-Key and bad enum rejected
scenarios.objective: Payroc verifies request validation and error envelope.
steps: POST /v1/payments without Idempotency-Key.
POST with an invalid channel value.
Read errors[].parameter.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 400 in both cases with RFC 7807 envelope and errors[].

scenarios.title: Worldnet: authenticate and obtain JWT
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies API-key authentication yields a Bearer JWT.
steps: GET /api/v1/account/authenticate with the API key (Basic).
Record expiresIn (hours) and use the Bearer JWT on later calls.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200 with a JWT and expiresIn.
scenarios.pitfalls: JWT lifetime is expiresIn hours and may change; refresh on 401. Never log the API key.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: card sale approved
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies a WEB keyed sale.
steps: POST /api/v1/transaction/payments with channel WEB and KEYED payload; Test Tag in order.orderId.
Store uniqueReference.
Check transaction status in the body.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with uniqueReference; TransactionResult.status READY or COMPLETE with approval.
scenarios.testData: Worldnet published test card Visa Credit 4539858876047062, any future expiry, CVV 3 digits (test-data-and-uat.md); use a full Worldnet test account
scenarios.pitfalls: orderId max 24 chars. Digits-only card number. Success only on approval, not on any response. Amount unit (decimal vs minor) should be confirmed against the spec.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: simulated decline, referral and CVV failure
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies decline handling using the cent-value simulator.
steps: Run sales with totalAmount ending .01 (declined), .02 (referral), .03 (CVV failure), per host simulator.
Confirm the application does not fulfil.
scenarios.expected: DECLINED / REFERRAL outcomes in the body; no fulfilment.
scenarios.testData: Cent values .01 declined, .02 referral, .03 CVV failure; others approve (e.g. 5.01 declines)
scenarios.pitfalls: Whether declines return 201 or an error status is not stated in the spec; confirm in sandbox.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: pre-authorization then capture
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies autoCapture false then capture.
steps: POST payments with autoCapture false.
PATCH /api/v1/transaction/payments/{uniqueReference}/capture (optional captureAmount).
scenarios.expected: Pre-auth created, capture succeeds.
scenarios.testData: Worldnet published test card Visa Credit 4539858876047062, any future expiry, CVV 3 digits (test-data-and-uat.md); use a full Worldnet test account
scenarios.pitfalls: Requires Allow Pre-Auth on the terminal else a PENDING transaction is created. 3DS does not support pre-auths.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: reverse (void) a payment
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies a reversal of an unsettled payment.
steps: PATCH /api/v1/transaction/payments/{uniqueReference}/reverse with optional reversalAmount and reversalReason.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 200; status REVERSAL.
scenarios.pitfalls: Spec intro shows a DELETE reverse link; follow the links actually returned.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: referenced refund (full and partial)
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies referenced refunds up to 100% cumulative.
steps: POST /api/v1/transaction/payments/{uniqueReference}/refunds for a partial amount.
Repeat for the remainder; attempt more than 100% and confirm rejection.
scenarios.expected: Refunds accepted up to the original amount; over-refund rejected (expected 422 business rule).
scenarios.pitfalls: For unsettled payments a refund may become a reversal. Refund request body fields are not detailed in the derived reference.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: unreferenced refund
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies standalone refunds (account must be enabled).
steps: Confirm enablement with Worldnet support and acquirer approval.
POST /api/v1/transaction/refunds.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 201 with refund uniqueReference.
scenarios.pitfalls: Needs a full test account, not the shared sandbox.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: bank transfer (ACH/PAD) payment and reversal
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies bank transfer payments and open-batch reversal.
steps: POST /api/v1/bankTransfer/payments with ACH or PAD payload.
GET the payment, then PATCH .../reverse while open.
scenarios.expected: Payment accepted; reversal succeeds before settlement.
scenarios.testData: Sandbox test data for ACH/PAD is not documented (confirm with Worldnet)

scenarios.title: Worldnet: 3-D Secure (MPI) then payment
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies MPI flow and threeDSecure GATEWAY on a WEB payment.
steps: POST to the MPI page; receive RESULT/MPIREF/STATUS/ECI on the MPI Receipt URL.
POST payment with threeDSecure {serviceProvider GATEWAY, mpiReference}.
scenarios.expected: RESULT A (ECI 05/06/07 per spec) then payment succeeds; RESULT D blocks payment.
scenarios.testData: 3DS challenge test data not documented (confirm with Worldnet)
scenarios.pitfalls: Requires 3DS enabled on terminal and an MPI Receipt URL; not supported for pre-auth.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: timeout recovery via lookup (no idempotency key)
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies a timed-out payment is resolved by lookup before retry, since no Idempotency-Key is documented.
steps: Send a payment and simulate a timeout.
Search GET /api/v1/transaction/transactions or GET payments/{uniqueReference} by orderId before any retry.
Retry only if no transaction exists.
scenarios.expected: No duplicate transaction is created.
scenarios.pitfalls: Do not assume Payroc's Idempotency-Key header applies to Worldnet.

scenarios.title: Worldnet: validation and error handling
scenarios.objective: Worldnet verifies error contract for malformed and business-rule failures.
steps: Send malformed JSON (expect 400).
Send a business-rule violation (expect 422).
Record debugIdentifier / X-Request-Id.
scenarios.expected: Error body with debugIdentifier and details[].
